feed.title: AI Benefits Database: feed of new and revised cases

entry.title: AI flags Julie Knichel's brain bleed before aneurysm treatment
entry.summary: Julie Knichel survived a ruptured aneurysm after AI-assisted detection and treatment, then returned to full-time nursing.

entry.title: AI helps locate Sophia Chan's aneurysm before emergency treatment
entry.summary: Sophia Chan survived a ruptured aneurysm after AI-assisted diagnosis and emergency treatment at Mayo Clinic.

entry.title: Lynxight alerts lifeguards to an unconscious swimmer
entry.summary: A swimmer recovered fully after a medical episode in Inglewood Pool. Lynxight alerted lifeguards while another swimmer brought him to the surface.

entry.title: COMPOSER sepsis alerts are linked to lower mortality
entry.summary: UC San Diego links COMPOSER to 17% lower sepsis mortality relative to a modeled counterfactual. The comparison was not randomized.

entry.title: Taiwan AI-ECG alerts reduce mortality in a randomized trial
entry.summary: A Taiwanese randomized trial involving 15,965 patients found 90-day mortality of 3.6% with AI-ECG alerts versus 4.3% with usual care.

entry.title: Manchester residents shape a proposed AI advice service
entry.summary: Manchester residents proposed safeguards for a public-facing Caddy service. Wider access to understandable advice remains intended; the panel’s design recommendations are reported.

entry.title: Peterborough develops OSCAR to connect council AI services
entry.summary: Peterborough and Datnexa are developing OSCAR to connect council services. The council reports that OSCAR Workforce is live, but has not supplied measured results.

entry.title: North East Derbyshire explores Copilot for routine work
entry.summary: North East Derbyshire uses Copilot for drafting, summaries, and analysis. Reduced repetitive work remains intended; the source does not establish an AI-produced cultural benefit.

entry.title: Milton Keynes reports faster planning validation with Valon
entry.summary: Milton Keynes reports faster validation and decisions during its Valon pilot, with receipt-to-validation time falling from 15.8 to 7.6 days.

entry.title: Leeds reports more planning applications processed with Xylo
entry.summary: Leeds reports over 40% more applications processed per officer, less research time, and improved officer wellbeing during its Xylo pilot.

entry.title: Bradford adds multilingual, out-of-hours social-care advice
entry.summary: Bradford reports that Annie handles about 50 conversations weekly, with 20% outside office hours and 74% user satisfaction.

entry.title: Huddersfield's first facial recognition vans: three arrests, six checks
entry.summary: West Yorkshire Police reported three arrests and six Sexual Harm Prevention Order checks in Huddersfield on August 12–14, 2026. Its register records nine alerts and an estimated 12,875 faces seen.

entry.title: Rapiscan CT algorithms detect marine wildlife at 86–96% in testing
entry.summary: A vendor-affiliated CT study reported 86–96% detection of three marine-wildlife classes and 13% overall false alarms; testing used original scans and synthetic composites, with no customs outcome.

entry.title: Transport for NSW trials PAWS wildlife cameras; no results yet
entry.summary: Transport for NSW's Protective Animal Warning System: two AI-enabled roadside cameras on a 13 km Monaro Highway stretch trigger driver warnings; trial announced 18 July 2026, no results yet.

entry.title: VTTI's Route 460 wildlife AI pilot slows drivers 3 mph at signs
entry.summary: One-year VTTI pilot for VDOT on Route 460 near Grundy: AI on thermal feeds triggered warning signs; 97% detection accuracy, 3 mph average slowdown; collisions prevented not established.

entry.title: UNEP records eight methane mitigations in Turkmenistan
entry.summary: UNEP lists eight mitigation cases, with site identifiers and dates from November 2024 to March 2026. The contribution of AI is described at system level, rather than isolated for each repair.

entry.title: wi.breathe cameras reportedly flag a Troizina wildfire
entry.summary: WINGS and Troizinia-Methana’s mayor credit wi.breathe with an August 2025 wildfire alert. Contemporary reporting describes spread and a substantial firefighting response.

entry.title: Ghost Murmur may have found downed F-15E officer
entry.summary: The rescue is documented. The claim that Ghost Murmur located the airman rests on two anonymous sources and a subsequent presidential remark; its technical capability remains unverified.

entry.title: Galaxy Watch4 Classic ECG flags AFib for Joseph Holycross, 39
entry.summary: Joseph Holycross says that a Galaxy Watch4 Classic ECG result prompted his ER visit, where doctors confirmed AFib. A week in hospital and open-heart surgery followed (CyberGuy, 2026).

entry.title: Apple Watch breathing alerts send a 79-year-old to CPAP therapy
entry.summary: Fukuoka case (Cureus, 26 May 2026): sleep-apnoea notifications prompted consultation; watch ECGs showed AF only after “elevated” breathing-disturbance nights; CPAP under way, no polysomnography.

entry.title: Wearable rhythm strips let a 59-year-old go straight to ablation
entry.summary: Virginia family physicians report that AF episodes a 59-year-old recorded on a consumer wearable, confirmed by a cardiologist, expedited referral and ablation; AF-free off drugs at follow-up.

entry.title: Smart wristwatch prompts ED readmission for pulmonary embolism
entry.summary: Toronto Western Hospital orthopedic surgeons report a smart wristwatch prompting ED readmission for postoperative pulmonary embolism investigation and management; details are limited to the abstract.

entry.title: MADGRAV recovers 47 cataloged LIGO events; no new candidate
entry.summary: Inguglia et al. (arXiv:2609.39583, 30 Sep 2026; v2 19 Oct 2026): sequential CNNs recover 47 cataloged high-mass events over 442.9 days of coincident LIGO data; no uncatalogued candidate survives.

entry.title: AI planning may have helped SKMC separate craniopagus twins
entry.summary: PureHealth/SKMC statement (5 June 2026) cites “AI-enhanced surgical planning”; XRlabs' own release claims AI-designed implants. The twins were separated in four operations and returned to Nigeria.

entry.title: ForeSight-HF scores two nursing-home heart-failure cases
entry.summary: Mount Sinai authors describe ForeSight-HF (GPT-5 mini on ProviderLoop) recommending diuresis for a warm/wet and de-escalation for a cold/dry nursing-home patient; both were managed independently.

entry.title: Mother's AI query prompts a rare-disease diagnosis in a 22-month-old
entry.summary: An unnamed AI app suggested a skull abnormality, prompting genetic evaluation of a 22-month-old. The authors attribute the app to Med-Gemini-3D, but its model is unverified.

entry.title: Nimbus's zasocitinib beats deucravacitinib in phase 3 trial
entry.summary: Takeda reports 36.5% complete skin clearance with zasocitinib versus 13.9% with deucravacitinib at week 16. The contribution of AI to discovery is not separately measured.

entry.title: OpenAI refers Darren Zhou's threats to the FBI; he pleads guilty
entry.summary: An OpenAI disclosure brought Darren Zhou’s threats to police attention; he pleaded guilty to stalking and threat charges and received probation, GPS monitoring, and contact and weapons restrictions.

entry.title: Greece presents AI to transcribe and check GSM-R rail dialogues
entry.summary: In a SKAI interview, Greece’s transport minister described AI transcription of GSM-R conversations and checks against railway communication protocols; no measured safety result was given.

entry.title: DeterTech AI cameras may have cut trespass at Dingwall
entry.summary: Network Rail reported fewer trespass incidents after installing DeterTech AI cameras at Dingwall, alongside signage and campaigns. It supplied no post-installation count and noted a renewed rise.

entry.title: WhaleSpotter thermal AI starts whale alerts in San Francisco Bay
entry.summary: WhaleSpotter’s thermal AI and human review feed whale alerts to San Francisco Bay mariners; independent reporters documented deployment and Coast Guard use, without a measured decline in strikes.

entry.title: Asilla's camera AI may have prompted two suicide interventions
entry.summary: Asilla told Kyodo that camera alerts prompted guards to intervene in two apparent suicide risks. The facilities and dates were not identified, and the company is the sole source of those accounts.

entry.title: o3-assisted reanalysis yields 11 new diagnoses and seven rediscoveries
entry.summary: AI-assisted reanalysis of 376 locally unresolved cases yielded 18 confirmed diagnoses. Eleven were new, while seven had already been established elsewhere.

entry.title: TIAA’s AI may have helped stop a scam involving retirement savings
entry.summary: TIAA’s CEO said that an AI flag, staff intervention, and contact with a participant’s daughter protected retirement savings of more than $3 million.

entry.title: Saronic Corsair sea drone picks up two Apache crew off Oman
entry.summary: A Navy Corsair sea drone picked up two Apache crew off Oman and carried them to a helicopter hoist; CENTCOM reported that both were rescued within about two hours.

entry.title: AI proposes a drug regimen for Joseph Coates’s POEMS syndrome
entry.summary: An AI repurposing model proposed a myeloma regimen for a dying POEMS patient; he improved in a week and reached transplant and remission.

entry.title: Double neural bypass restores Keith Thomas's movement and touch
entry.summary: Keith Thomas, paralyzed since 2020, regained arm movement and touch after a 15-hour brain-implant operation in Manhasset, New York.

entry.title: Study suggests seven-day flood warnings in parts of Mali
entry.summary: Forecasts could allow earlier action in parts of Mali, but Google Flood Hub produced frequent false alarms. No benefit from an implemented early action was measured.

entry.title: NHC blends DeepMind's ensemble into Hurricane Melissa forecasts
entry.summary: NHC blended Google DeepMind's AI ensemble into official Melissa forecasts from its first advisory on 21 October 2025; Cat 5 landfall in Jamaica 28 October 2025.

entry.title: Generate Biomedicines' AI-designed GB-0669 completes phase 1
entry.summary: Phase 1 of the AI-designed antibody GB-0669 in 51 healthy adults showed tolerability, a 54-day half-life and dose-dependent virus neutralization.

entry.title: BenevolentAI graph proposes baricitinib; trials cut mortality
entry.summary: AI knowledge graph proposed baricitinib in Feb 2020; ACTT-2 showed faster recovery and COV-BARRIER lower 28-day mortality (a secondary endpoint); FDA and WHO endorsed it.

entry.title: Apple Watch Fall Detection calls 112 after runner's VF collapse
entry.summary: Apple Watch Fall Detection called 112 and family after a runner's VF collapse near Varsseveld on 1 January 2026; CPR at 6–7 min, full neurological recovery.

entry.title: Warwickshire food-mapping AI trails simpler method: 63% versus 95%
entry.summary: Warwickshire’s LLM achieved 63% classification accuracy versus 95% for a simpler method. Faster food-access mapping remains intended; improved food access is not established.

entry.title: Milton Keynes offers hands-on AI learning and interactive demonstrations
entry.summary: Milton Keynes offered a practical AI workshop and interactive demonstrations in 2024. Better understanding, confidence, and feedback remain intended benefits without measured changes.

entry.title: Liverpool plans multilingual AI concierges for summit attendees
entry.summary: Liverpool's 2024 AI Summit planned interactive digital humans to assist attendees and host proceedings. Easier access to event information remains an intended benefit without a measured outcome.

entry.title: Nara proposes AI voice control for an accessible metaverse
entry.summary: Nara's patent specifies AI voice control for an accessible metaverse. The Blind Metaverse demo uses speech synthesis; deployment of the patented speech recognition is unverified.

entry.title: Newham proposes AI forecasting for temporary-accommodation planning
entry.summary: Newham Council and the University of East London propose using existing data to forecast housing demand and homelessness trends. Better temporary-accommodation planning remains an intended benefit.

entry.title: Proposed AI rainfall prediction for basin irrigation
entry.summary: IARI proposes AI rainfall prediction to avoid unnecessary irrigation when rain is expected. The report separates this proposed extension from its existing soil-moisture automation.

entry.title: Proposed AI decision support for human resources
entry.summary: A UAE research project proposes AI decision support for HR personnel. Better decisions, lower costs, and reduced hiring bias remain intended benefits.

entry.title: Wigan reports time savings and newly usable survey responses
entry.summary: Wigan reports 107 staff days saved on minutes and new analysis of 4,500 tenant responses through QuickAction tools.

entry.title: West Oxfordshire and Cotswold report less planning admin
entry.summary: West Oxfordshire and Cotswold report 85% less repetitive planning-administration time with AI tagging and summaries of consultation feedback.

entry.title: West Berkshire reports quicker job-advert drafting with GPT
entry.summary: West Berkshire reports faster, more consistently formatted job adverts from its GPT tool, with low stated setup and running costs.

entry.title: The Amelia Scott reports better scans and expanded digital exhibits
entry.summary: The Amelia Scott reports 50% faster image processing, improved scans, interactive exhibits, and volunteers progressing to paid museum roles.

entry.title: West Midlands uses near-miss data to change road layouts
entry.summary: Transport for West Midlands reports 61,000 detected near misses and road-layout changes informed by AI. Avoided injuries are not established.

entry.title: Swindon reports cheaper, faster Easy-Read documents
entry.summary: Swindon reports that Simply Readable creates Easy-Read documents in under 30 minutes at much lower cost, with input from residents with learning disabilities.

entry.title: Surrey Heath explores Copilot meeting and email summaries
entry.summary: Surrey Heath reports promising meeting-recap and email-summary tests with two Copilot licenses. It has not established a business case or quantified gains.

entry.title: St Helens uses AI to match care needs and draft care plans
entry.summary: St Helens built AI tools that match care assessments to a technology catalog and draft personalized care plans. Improved resident independence remains an intended benefit.

entry.title: South Cambridgeshire reports fewer calls and better routing
entry.summary: South Cambridgeshire reports lower call volumes after chatbot rollout and better call classification, without numerical savings or satisfaction results.

entry.title: Somerset reports time savings and improved staff focus
entry.summary: Somerset reports two to four hours saved weekly per Copilot user, with 75% reporting better focus and 53% finding work more enjoyable.

entry.title: Peterborough reports quicker advice through Hey Geraldine
entry.summary: Peterborough reports 15 minutes saved per conversation with Hey Geraldine. A manager describes obtaining equipment information while a colleague was away.
